Alongside these preset options, players could opt to use their current loadout as the first choice. However, if one's loadout contained no towers, this option would be unavailable. ==Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts were additive. ===Badges=== There was also a [[Badges|badge]] which could be obtained when playing this map: {{Badge |title = Live Event 9/25 |image = LiveEvent925Badge.png |obtainable = Yes }} ==Wave Structure== '''Bolded''' names indicate an enemy type's debut.
